column3: MT 10:32. “Take” is rendered “buy.” “We will leave the seventh year and usury of every hand” is rendered “we will forego the crops the seventh year and the exaction of every debt”; NASB supplies “the crops.”
MT 10:33. “Establish on ourselves commandments” is rendered “placed ourselves under obligation.”
MT 10:34. “The bread of the row” is rendered “the showbread,” and “regularity” as “continual.”
MT 10:35. “The offering of the wood” is rendered “the supply of wood,” and “a year in a year” as “annually.”
MT 10:36. “A year in a year” is rendered “annually.”
MT 10:37. Word order is changed; “who serve” is rendered “who are ministering.”
MT 10:38. “The choicest of our dough” is rendered “the first of our dough,” and “store-rooms” as “chambers.” “The cities of our labor” is rendered “the rural towns.”
MT 10:39. “Collect” is rendered “receive,” and “the store-rooms of the house of the treasury” as “the chambers of the storehouse.”
MT 10:40. “Store-rooms” is rendered “chambers,” and “who serve” as “who are ministering.” NASB adds “Thus.”
